name: Agent Map
description: See how a Copilot Studio agent is built. The Agent Map shows the skills, tools, knowledge sources, connected agents, topics, triggers, and evaluation sets of an agent, and how they connect.

conversation_starters.title: Map a Copilot Studio agent
conversation_starters.text: Show me the agent map of a Copilot Studio agent.

conversation_starters.title: Map an agent by name
conversation_starters.text: Show the agent map for [agent name].

conversation_starters.title: Map an agent in an environment
conversation_starters.text: Show the agent map for [agent name] in environment [environment name].
